metadata.title: That 3 kill spree where my aim was totally on vacation LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I got 3 kills but I swear my brain was AFK.
Enemy probably thinking ‘Did I just get outplayed or did they glitch?’
Click if your best plays feel like accidental legends!

Tap if your aim ghosts but your kills still happen!
